title: Grateful Dead Live at The Centrum on 1983-10-21
lineage: Dat (Panasonic SV-3700) > Tascam DA-3000 > wav 16/44; Edited & Mastered in Audacity by Joe Noel; Wave > Flac 16/44; Checksum & tags created in xACT
source: Jeff Silberman Recording FOB (2nd row) Sennheiser 441's > Technics PCM master > DAT; Charlie Miller

ai_review.summary: Crystal‑clear FOB capture of Fall ’83 magic with massive Scarlet → Fire and wandering Uncle John’s > Playing in the Band.
ai_review.review: The front‑of‑house recording is a revelation – Sennheiser mics deliver an airy, rich mix where Phil’s bass shines and the audience sits back. Musically the show is a high‑water mark of the fall ’83 tour, highlighted by a monster Scarlet Begonias → Fire on the Mountain transition and a satisfying Uncle John's Band → Playing in the Band sequence.

ai_rating.rationale: Both reviewers gave 5‑star ratings, praising the performance and describing the recording as crystal‑clear and superior to previous boards.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Front‑of‑house Sennheiser capture; extremely clear, full hall mix with audience low in the mix, Phil’s bass especially rich and fluid.

standout_songs: Scarlet Begonias > Fire on the Mountain
Uncle John's Band > Playing in the Band
show_quality.setlist_flow: Smooth, lilt‑filled flow with Swiss‑watch timing; steady Eddie performance throughout set 1 and a solid post‑Space segment.

band_member_comments.Phil: Rich, fluid tone highlighted in the mix; prominent and satisfying bass work.
